summary: Trinity Resources Inc. operates as a company specializing in mineral exploration and mining development. It primarily concentrates on projects involving gold, silver, and platinum group metals throughout North and South America. The firm notably possesses interests in the Eureka Placer Claim, which is located in Eureka Creek, California. It was formerly named TruLan Resources Inc. before rebranding as Trinity Resources Inc. in September 2015. The company's principal place of business is in Henderson, Nevada.
